tool_signatures.name: accept_subgoal
tool_signatures.description: Accept a subgoal after all associated tasks are accepted by audit_task. Supports both legacy status=accepted and done_by_agent with acceptance_status=accepted.

tool_signatures.name: apply_patch
tool_signatures.description: Apply JSON patch operations to a file within a Direct session

tool_signatures.name: artifact_hygiene
tool_signatures.description: ${trackedArtifacts} tracked build artifact change(s) require intentional source-control review.

tool_signatures.name: auditSession
tool_signatures.description: Direct support module checks

tool_signatures.name: auditTask
tool_signatures.description: Direct tool module checks

tool_signatures.name: audit_session
tool_signatures.description: Independently audit a Direct session

tool_signatures.name: audit_task
tool_signatures.description: Independently audit a task

tool_signatures.name: cancel_task
tool_signatures.description: Request graceful cancellation. The runner that owns the child process performs termination; the MCP server never kills a PID read from task files.

tool_signatures.name: check_release_gate
tool_signatures.description: v1.0.0: Verify release readiness across five sequential stages: local_ready → packed_ready → published_verified → github_release_verified → ci_verified. Remote stages (published/github/ci) query npm registry and GitHub API via node:https read-only GET; network errors return

tool_signatures.name: create_direct_session
tool_signatures.description: Create a Direct editing session for ChatGPT to apply patches directly. Requires enableDirectProfile: true in config.

tool_signatures.name: create_file
tool_signatures.description: Create a new bounded UTF-8 text file inside an active Direct session. The target and its parent are revalidated, sensitive content is blocked, and existing targets are never overwritten.

tool_signatures.name: create_goal
tool_signatures.description: v0.8.0: Create a Goal Session for managing a multi-task objective with subgoal dependencies. Generates a structured directory under .patchwarden/goals/{goal_id}/ with GOAL.md, GOALS.md, and goal_status.json. Use list_goals to enumerate existing goals and read_goal to inspect details.

tool_signatures.name: create_subgoal_task
tool_signatures.description: v0.8.0: Create a subgoal within a Goal Session and immediately launch an associated task. Atomically: addSubgoal → create_task → linkTask → mark subgoal running. The subgoal depends_on other subgoals (by id) which must be accepted before suggest_next_subgoal returns it.

tool_signatures.name: create_task
tool_signatures.description: Create a repo-scoped task from exactly one source. For ChatGPT, prefer the guarded inspect_only, feature_small, or fix_tests template when it fits. A stale watcher preserves the task but returns execution_blocked and directs the client to health_check; otherwise call wait_for_task until terminal. Use execution_mode=assess_only to pre-assess risk and get an assessment_id without creating a task; then invoke the returned next_tool_call using only execution_mode=execute and the full assessment_id.

tool_signatures.name: delete_file
tool_signatures.description: Delete one bounded regular text file inside a Direct session. Requires the current SHA-256 and confirm_delete=true; directories and recursive deletion are unsupported.

tool_signatures.name: diagnose_task
tool_signatures.description: v0.7.0: Diagnose a running or collecting_artifacts task using multi-signal evidence (heartbeat age, log freshness, child PID liveness, watcher ownership, artifact presence). Returns a conservative diagnosis (active_running, stale_running, possibly_stale_running, orphaned_running, artifact_collection_stuck, done_candidate, unknown, terminal) with confidence level and safe_actions. Never relies on a single signal; refuses to call PID-alive tasks

tool_signatures.name: discard_worktree
tool_signatures.description: v1.0.0: Discard an isolated git worktree safely. Removes the worktree (git worktree remove --force), deletes its branch, and archives status as

tool_signatures.name: discover_tools
tool_signatures.description: v0.7.1: Search candidate tools by natural-language query (Chinese or English). Returns compressed summaries with risk level and schema digest. Filters by profile/mode/riskCeiling. High-risk tools (command/release/credential_sensitive) are hidden by default unless includeHighRisk=true. Read-only — never invokes tools.

tool_signatures.name: document_command_sources
tool_signatures.description: Command

tool_signatures.name: explain_tool
tool_signatures.description: v0.7.1: Expand a single tool

tool_signatures.name: export_goal_report
tool_signatures.description: Export a structured final report for a Goal session, aggregating subgoal completion, task evidence, and risk summary.

tool_signatures.name: export_handoff
tool_signatures.description: v0.8.0: Export a handoff.md document for transferring a Goal Session to a new conversation. Includes current goal, completed/pending subgoals, recent diff/test results, blockers, next steps, and risks. Writes to .patchwarden/goals/{goal_id}/handoff.md.

tool_signatures.name: export_task_evidence_pack
tool_signatures.description: Export a bounded evidence pack for a run_task_loop lineage. Writes evidence.json and EVIDENCE.md without stdout, stderr, full logs, full diff, or sensitive file contents.

tool_signatures.name: finalize_direct_session
tool_signatures.description: Finalize a Direct session: capture after snapshot, generate diff/summary/change artifacts, mark session as finalized. Must be called before audit_session.

tool_signatures.name: get_diff
tool_signatures.description: Read task diff evidence, or return structured availability and watcher evidence while it is not ready.

tool_signatures.name: get_plan
tool_signatures.description: Read a saved plan by its plan_id.

tool_signatures.name: get_project_policy
tool_signatures.description: Read the bounded effective .patchwarden/project-policy.json summary for a repository. Missing policy returns safe defaults. Project policy never expands PatchWarden command allow-lists, workspace confinement, sensitive-path blocking, or watcher/audit boundaries.

tool_signatures.name: get_result
tool_signatures.description: Read result.md, or return structured availability and watcher evidence while the task is not terminal.

tool_signatures.name: get_result_json
tool_signatures.description: Read the structured result.json for deterministic task acceptance.

tool_signatures.name: get_task_lineage
tool_signatures.description: Read a bounded safe summary for a run_task_loop lineage. Does not return full logs, diffs, stdout, stderr, or markdown artifacts.

tool_signatures.name: get_task_log_tail
tool_signatures.description: Read the last N lines of a task log file (stdout/stderr/test/verify) with automatic secret redaction. Default 80 lines, max 200. Always returns tail only — never the full file. Use this instead of read_workspace_file to avoid triggering platform content filters on log output.

tool_signatures.name: get_task_progress
tool_signatures.description: Read progress.md for task phases and the most recent heartbeat/current command.

tool_signatures.name: get_task_status
tool_signatures.description: Check task status, execution phase, watcher health, pending reason, current command, timeout, and change evidence.

tool_signatures.name: get_task_stdout_tail
tool_signatures.description: Read the last N lines of agent stdout/stderr. Reads from real-time stdout.log/stderr.log during execution, falls back to result.md after completion. Works on pending, running, and completed tasks. Default 80 lines.

tool_signatures.name: get_task_summary
tool_signatures.description: Return structured acceptance evidence. Use view=compact first for bounded counts and risk excerpts; use standard only when full changed-file and log-tail detail is required.

tool_signatures.name: get_test_log
tool_signatures.description: Read test.log, or return structured availability and watcher evidence while it is not ready.

tool_signatures.name: health_check
tool_signatures.description: Check MCP catalog consistency, watcher freshness/supervisor state, workspace readiness, and configured agents. Agent availability is executable-only unless an explicit provider probe is requested. Use detail=self_diagnostic for expanded read-only evidence.

tool_signatures.name: import_speckit_tasks
tool_signatures.description: Import Spec Kit tasks into a Goal session as subgoals, mapping task files to scope hints and acceptance criteria.

tool_signatures.name: invoke_discovered_tool
tool_signatures.description: v0.8.1: Invoke a previously discovered tool using a discoveryToken. The token must be obtained from discover_tools first. Enforces 10 security checks: token validity, toolName match, profile allowance, risk ceiling, sensitive path guard, assessment requirement, command whitelist, release confirmation, credential block, and invocation logging. Cannot call itself recursively.

tool_signatures.name: kill_task
tool_signatures.description: Request immediate termination of a pending or running task. The runner validates and kills only the child process it owns.

tool_signatures.name: list_agents
tool_signatures.description: List agents from the active runtime config, verify executable and model-argument wiring, and report the config path used by this process. provider_status remains not_checked because this read-only check does not contact a model provider or test account balance.

tool_signatures.name: list_goals
tool_signatures.description: v0.8.0: List all Goal Sessions with completion summaries. Returns goal_id, title, status, subgoal counts, and last update time. Sorted by updated_at descending.

tool_signatures.name: list_tasks
tool_signatures.description: List recent tasks with status/repo/active/history filters plus watcher state and computed pending reasons. Archived history is excluded by default.

tool_signatures.name: list_workspace
tool_signatures.description: List files and directories within the workspace (sensitive files excluded).

tool_signatures.name: merge_worktree
tool_signatures.description: v1.0.0: Merge an isolated git worktree

tool_signatures.name: mkdir
tool_signatures.description: Create one new directory level inside an active Direct session. Parent directories must already exist; linked, sensitive, internal, dependency, release, and build-output paths remain blocked.

tool_signatures.name: move_file
tool_signatures.description: Move one bounded regular text file within a Direct session. Requires the current source SHA-256 and never overwrites the target.

tool_signatures.name: read_goal
tool_signatures.description: v0.8.0: Read full Goal Session details including GOAL.md content, goal_status.json, and all subgoals with dependency info. Use after list_goals to inspect a specific goal.

tool_signatures.name: read_workspace_file
tool_signatures.description: Read a file within the workspace. Sensitive files (secrets, keys, tokens) are blocked. In Direct mode (with session_id), reads are scoped to the session

tool_signatures.name: recommend_agent_for_task
tool_signatures.description: Return a bounded read-only agent routing recommendation for a repo-scoped task. Does not start an agent, create a task, or read logs.

tool_signatures.name: reconcile_tasks
tool_signatures.description: v0.7.0: Scan stale running/collecting_artifacts tasks and either report or safely fix them. report_only (default) returns a diagnosis report without modifying state. safe_fix additionally writes high-confidence status transitions (failed_stale/orphaned/done_by_agent) atomically with backup (status.json.bak), audit fields, and an appended reconcile.log. Never touches tasks still owned by an active watcher; never applies medium/low confidence fixes.

tool_signatures.name: reject_subgoal
tool_signatures.description: Reject a subgoal with a reason. Allowed from any non-terminal status (ready/queued/running/done_by_agent/needs_fix). Records rejected_reason in goal_status.json.

tool_signatures.name: release_check
tool_signatures.description: v1.3.0: Run a bounded release readiness check by wrapping the existing release gate. Local stages use existing guarded release-gate commands; remote stages are read-only. Does not publish, push, tag, or create a GitHub Release.

tool_signatures.name: release_claims_unverified
tool_signatures.description: ${allReleaseClaims.length} remote publish/release/deploy claim(s) found in docs. PatchWarden cannot independently verify npm/GitHub actions. Manual confirmation required.

tool_signatures.name: release_cleanup
tool_signatures.description: v1.3.0: Clean up release artifacts using project-policy auto_cleanup rules. Defaults to dry_run=true. Non-dry-run cleanup only removes low-risk ignored/untracked artifacts under repo_path and writes an audit summary.

tool_signatures.name: release_prepare
tool_signatures.description: v1.3.0: Run project-policy release preparation commands only when each command is already accepted by the existing PatchWarden command guard. Returns command status only, never stdout/stderr. Does not publish, push, tag, or create a GitHub Release.

tool_signatures.name: release_verify
tool_signatures.description: v1.3.0: Verify npm/GitHub/CI release facts with read-only HTTPS requests. Does not run local shell commands and does not publish, push, tag, or create a GitHub Release.

tool_signatures.name: repo_path_consistency
tool_signatures.description: repo_path inconsistent with workspace.

tool_signatures.name: request_direct_review
tool_signatures.description: Request a policy-bound review for the exact Direct operation to be performed. In enforce mode, pass the returned review_id unchanged to the matching operation before it expires.

tool_signatures.name: result_md_exists
tool_signatures.description: No result.md — cannot verify what agent did.

tool_signatures.name: retry_task
tool_signatures.description: Create a new task with the same plan, agent, repo_path, and test_command as an existing task. The original task is unchanged.

tool_signatures.name: run_direct_verification_bundle
tool_signatures.description: Run multiple allowlisted Direct verification commands sequentially and return only bounded structured status. Omits stdout/stderr tails and log content.

tool_signatures.name: run_task
tool_signatures.description: Manually trigger execution of a pending task. WARNING: requires enableRunTaskTool=true in config. Prefer using the local watcher instead.

tool_signatures.name: run_task_loop
tool_signatures.description: Start a guarded PatchWarden task loop by composing create_task, wait_for_task, safe summaries, and audit_task. By default it returns request_id, lineage_id, and the created main task immediately while Core continues the loop in the background; follow with wait_for_task and get_task_lineage. It does not bypass the watcher, command allow-list, workspace confinement, or confirmation boundaries.

tool_signatures.name: run_verification
tool_signatures.description: Run a whitelisted verification command within a Direct session. Command must be in the Direct allowlist.

tool_signatures.name: safe_audit
tool_signatures.description: Run audit_task and return only bounded structured audit evidence without full review markdown.

tool_signatures.name: safe_audit_direct_session
tool_signatures.description: Audit a Direct session and return only bounded structured evidence without verification stdout/stderr tails.

tool_signatures.name: safe_diff_summary
tool_signatures.description: Return changed-file counts and bounded path metadata without returning diff content.

tool_signatures.name: safe_direct_summary
tool_signatures.description: Return a low-noise Direct session summary without diff content or verification stdout/stderr tails.

tool_signatures.name: safe_finalize_direct_session
tool_signatures.description: Finalize a Direct session and return only bounded structured evidence, omitting diff and verification log content.

tool_signatures.name: safe_result
tool_signatures.description: Return a low-noise structured task result summary without full logs, markdown, or diff content.

tool_signatures.name: safe_status
tool_signatures.description: Return minimal task lifecycle status without exposing diff, log content, file contents, or sensitive paths. Use this when only task state is needed and content-bearing tools may be blocked by upper-layer security.

tool_signatures.name: safe_test_summary
tool_signatures.description: Return a compact verification summary for a task without stdout/stderr or test log content.

tool_signatures.name: save_plan
tool_signatures.description: Save an execution plan — ChatGPT writes the plan, PatchWarden stores it for local agent execution. Supports plan_ref to load a plan file already placed inside .patchwarden/plans.

tool_signatures.name: search_workspace
tool_signatures.description: Search file contents (grep-like) within a Direct session

tool_signatures.name: suggest_next_subgoal
tool_signatures.description: v0.8.0: Suggest the next executable subgoal based on the dependency graph. Returns a ready subgoal whose dependencies are all accepted. If none ready, returns blocked_by list. Use to drive goal-directed task sequencing.

tool_signatures.name: summarize_goal_progress
tool_signatures.description: Summarize goal completion: counts by status (accepted/rejected/queued/running/ready/needs_fix/done_by_agent), completion_rate, blocked_subgoals, and actionable risks.

tool_signatures.name: sync_file
tool_signatures.description: Copy a file from source to target within the same Direct session repo. This legacy operation is outside the first Direct review MVP and is disabled when directReview.mode=enforce. Both paths must be inside the session repo_path.

tool_signatures.name: test_exit_code
tool_signatures.description: Tests failed with exit code ${exitCode}.

tool_signatures.name: wait_for_task
tool_signatures.description: Long-poll a task for up to 30 seconds. If continuation_required=true, call wait_for_task again immediately and do not finish the assistant turn. Terminal responses include get_task_summary acceptance evidence.
